title: Refunds can exceed the original payment
body:
`Refunds.Apply` in `billing/refund.go` no longer checks the payment amount, so a refund of 5000 cents against a 1000 cent payment succeeds.

Expected: `Apply` returns `ErrTooLarge` when the amount is more than the payment, and nothing is written.

Done when a test in `billing/refund_test.go` covers both cases and `go test ./...` passes.

title: Checkout is slow
body: Customers say checkout feels slow sometimes. Can we make it faster?

title: Format negative amounts with a minus sign
body:
`billing.Format(-150)` in `billing/invoice.go` returns `$-1.-50`. It should return `-$1.50`.

Add cases for negative, zero, and amounts under a dollar to the table test for `Format` in `billing/invoice_test.go`. Done when those cases pass with `go test ./...`.

title: Move to multi-currency billing
body: We need to support EUR, GBP, and JPY across invoices, refunds, payouts, tax reports, and the admin dashboard, and migrate existing amounts. Pricing should follow the customer's country.

title: Add a webhook retry
body:
Order webhooks are sent once by `webhooks.Deliver` in `webhooks/deliver.go`. When a delivery fails, retry it up to 3 times with backoff (1s, 5s, 30s), then mark the delivery failed in the dashboard.
